Learning Engineering & STEM Education

Dr. Divya C. Senan

Director & Associate Professor

Qualification:

Ph.D. in Education (Univ. of Kerala), Postdoc (Univ. of Alabama in Huntsville, USA)

Specialization:

Learning Engineering, STEM Pedagogy, Climate & Energy Literacy, AI Computational Modeling

Professional Bio:

Director of the Centre for Learning Engineering and Sustainability Education (LEnSE) and Associate Professor at the Department of Education, University of Kerala. Fulbright-Nehru & UGC-Raman Postdoctoral Fellow with over 18 years of academic leadership.

Fulbright-Nehru Postdoctoral Fellow (USA)UGC-Raman FellowNational Educator Innovation Award

International STEM Collaboration & Clean Tech

Prof. Jan De Waters

Honorary International Visiting Scholar

Qualification:

Ph.D. in Environmental Science & Engineering (Clarkson University, USA)

Specialization:

International STEM Collaboration, Energy Literacy Benchmarks, Clean Technology Pedagogy

Directs international academic engagement between Clarkson University USA and LEnSE University of Kerala. Served as Chief Guest at the 4th SIET International Conference on Educational Technology.
